title: The Foul-Mouthed Myna Bird
notes: Detective-cast (Conan, Kogoro, Megure, Detective Boys) omitted by convention; the unnamed neighborhood children who verify Mamoru's alibi and the unnamed mother/passersby who fail to verify Emi's are referenced only in attrs since they're never named. case_type: murder. The old cases/ file's culprit call (Sayama) is confirmed correct by the transcript -- no reversal needed. Two corrections vs. the old file: (1) the old file's clue text calls the marker 'red string'; the transcript is explicit that the point of the clue is Sayama correctly identifying it as 'yarn' (not string/a natural marking) despite claiming to have only glimpsed the bird in passing, and that the yarn was tied on 'this morning' -- knowledge only available to someone already at the house. (2) the old file captured only that one clue; the transcript has a second, equally load-bearing testimonial clue (Nine parroting Sayama's own remark that a room -- the pickle basement -- 'stinks', which he could only know by having explored past the rear-entrance flowerpot task he claimed was his only reason for being on that side of the house), which is added here as a second clue node.

attrs.temperament: trusted no one after being betrayed; taught her pet myna bird only insults, believing compliments to be lies
attrs.backstory: publicly accused of plagiarizing her mentor; insiders say it was actually the mentor who plagiarized her, but the media sided with the bigger name and she was forced to stop writing

attrs.alibi: seen entering the house at 13:55 by neighborhood children playing in the park across the street
attrs.note: frequently asked his aunt for money despite her scolding him; she nonetheless told others she believed he'd be successful

attrs.financial_pressure: mother long-term ill; medical bills piling up, was asking Naoko for a raise
attrs.alibi: claims she was shopping 13:00-14:00 but was delayed helping search for the mother of an abandoned stroller-bound baby; could not name the mother or the two passersby who helped her
attrs.key_access: one of only two people with a key to the side entrance, along with the victim

attrs.claimed_injury: dominant hand/arm injured; claimed he could not drive or grip anything for three more days per his doctor
attrs.alibi: on the phone with the victim from Midoridai Station at 12:55, walking to Midoridai Hospital while the call continued until 13:35
attrs.true_alibi: used the ongoing phone call to mask that he detoured to the victim's house instead of continuing straight to the hospital

attrs.side_entrance: semi-automatic lock, only two keys existed (victim and Emi); locks itself shut on exit
attrs.basement: used to store the victim's pickles; source of the stench Sayama was overheard describing

attrs.detail: worn around the victim's neck; used to strangle her

attrs.trained_speech: only ever taught insults by the victim, who believed compliments were lies
attrs.leg_marker: victim tied a red yarn band to Nine's leg that same morning to make him identifiable if he escaped again
attrs.escape: got out through a window left open during the on-scene investigation, after the murder

attrs.detail: book Sayama unknowingly sold Naoko as genuine; discovering the forgery is what triggered her demand for restitution
victim had Sayama carry it in through the rear/side entrance after summoning him there; its presence in the kitchen proves he used that entrance, not the main door

clues.desc: Sayama describes seeing Nine trailing red yarn (not string) 'on the way to the hospital', and knows it was tied on 'this morning' -- details only available if he had already been at the house after the bird's post-murder escape, not merely passing by on the road hours earlier.

Nine parrots Sayama's own remark that a room 'stinks' -- the pickle-storage basement -- which he could only have said if he'd explored past the rear entrance where he claims he only set down a flowerpot.

edges.motive_type: humiliation/revenge -- publicly humiliated and forced into demeaning restitution tasks despite his arm injury
financial desperation (red herring) -- mounting medical bills for her mother, denied a raise
financial resentment (red herring) -- unemployed, repeatedly asked her for money and was refused

edges.detail: summons him to the side entrance and orders him to bring in a flowerpot via the rear entrance while berating him over the unpaid restitution

edges.method: strangled her with her own stole despite his claimed inability to use his dominant hand
